explanation: A low gear makes the back wheel turn fewer times per pedal turn. The effort is spread differently: less force is needed per push, but the bike advances less each turn.

options.text: Each pedal turn moves the bike farther, with less effort
Pedalling becomes easier, but each pedal turn moves the bike a shorter distance
The chain grips the wheel more tightly
Your legs produce more power than in a high gear
